Package org.apache.juneau.server.config.repository

Class GitControl

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.server.config.repository.GitControl
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class GitControl extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Git repository control operations for cloning, pulling, pushing, and committing.

Provides a simplified wrapper around JGit for server configuration repository management. Used to fetch configuration files from a remote Git repository.

The underlying JGit Repository and Git handles are opened in the constructor and released by close(), so instances must be used with try-with-resources to avoid leaking file/native handles.

  • Constructor Details

    • GitControl

      public GitControl(String localPath, String remotePath) throws IOException
      Constructor.

      Equivalent to GitControl(localPath, remotePath, null, null, false): no credentials (anonymous transport) and non-force push.

      Parameters:
      localPath - Local directory path for the repository.
      remotePath - Remote Git repository URI.
      Throws:
      IOException - If the repository cannot be opened.

    • GitControl

      public GitControl(String localPath, String remotePath, String username, String password, boolean forcePush) throws IOException
      Constructor.

      Credentials are supplied by the caller (typically from operator configuration or a secret store) rather than hardcoded. Pass null for username to use anonymous transport.

      Parameters:
      localPath - Local directory path for the repository.
      remotePath - Remote Git repository URI.
      username - Git username, or null for anonymous transport.
      password - Git password/token. Ignored when username is null.
      forcePush - Whether pushToRepo() performs a force-push (destructive remote history rewrite).
      Force-push is opt-in; defaults to false in the other constructors.
      Throws:
      IOException - If the repository cannot be opened.

  • Method Details

    • close

      public void close()
      Closes the underlying JGit Git and Repository handles.

      The Git instance wraps an externally-supplied Repository (it does not close it on Git.close()), so both are released explicitly here.

      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
